# Universitas Airlangga (UNAIR)

> Indonesia's leading research university offering comprehensive education across 15 faculties with emphasis on health sciences, community engagement, and sustainable development.

Universitas Airlangga is a major Indonesian university headquartered in Surabaya with campuses in Banyuwangi, featuring extensive programs from diploma through doctoral levels, active research initiatives, and commitment to the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

## Key Topics

- Universitas Airlangga (UNAIR)
- Student Admission (PPMB)
